document:0:629:0.text:
...
Whatever school a living mage chooses, their magic gradually becomes bound to their life force. Gravecalling is the sole exception—death energy is incompatible with life, so this bond can never form.
When a mage dies, any life-bound magic dies with them. Should they rise as Graveborn, that life-bound magic may vanish completely or remain sealed beyond reach. Only magic that never formed the bond can still be used.
Fortunately, this need not be permanent. By studying gravecalling, a Graveborn mage can reshape the bond and eventually reclaim the magical power they held in life. From then on, however, every spell must be built on gravecalling principles.
(The rest contains nothing useful.)
document:0:629:0.source_cn:
………………………………
对于生者而言，在学习魔法的过程中，无论其主攻何种魔法，其魔力都将逐渐与其生命绑定。唯一的例外是研究亡灵魔法的生者，由于死亡力量与生命状态本身互斥，其魔力无法绑定。
魔法师逝世后，魔力将随生命一同消散。如果不幸变为亡灵，已经与生命状态绑定的魔力或是受到限制、无法发挥，或是直接消散，只有尚未绑定的部分魔力仍可以利用。
幸运的是，此种魔力状态可逆，只需持续不断研究亡灵魔法，即可改变魔力的绑定，令自己的魔法水平回归与生前一致的水平。只是此后所使用的魔法都基于亡灵魔法的基础之上。
（后面没有任何有价值的信息）

say:31:1820712524:0.male: If you're still worried, <style="highlight">ask those two mortals to teach you some swordplay</style>. From the way they carry themselves, both have seen plenty of combat.
say:31:1820712524:0.female: If you're still worried, <style="highlight">ask those two mortals to teach you some swordplay</style>. From the way they carry themselves, both have seen plenty of combat.

say:32:1820712525:0.text: Now off with you. I have work to do.
say:32:1820712525:0.source_cn: 好了，老身还有自己的事要忙，你且离开吧。
say:32:1820712525:0.male: Now off with you. I have work to do.
say:32:1820712525:0.female: Now off with you. I have work to do.

choice:28:0:1.text: First, I need a way to keep Twilight Village safe...
choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 我得想想有什么办法能保护夕染村……
choice:28:0:1.male: First, I need a way to keep Twilight Village safe...
choice:28:0:1.female: First, I need a way to keep Twilight Village safe...

choice:18:0:1.text: A lot of good that does me while it's asleep.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 真遗憾，现在发挥不出来
choice:18:0:1.male: A lot of good that does me while it's asleep.
choice:18:0:1.female: A lot of good that does me while it's asleep.

choice:18:1:2.text: I knew I was stronger than her!
choice:18:1:2.male: I knew I was stronger than her!
choice:18:1:2.female: I knew I was stronger than her!

choice:9:0:1.text: What do you mean when you say my soul and body are one?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 我不太懂灵魂与躯体一体的意思
choice:9:0:1.male: What do you mean when you say my soul and body are one?
choice:9:0:1.female: What do you mean when you say my soul and body are one?

say:34:1820712503:0.text: No. You simply fainted. I didn't expect the potion to have no effect on you.
say:34:1820712503:0.source_cn: 你昏过去了。老身也没有料到，那药竟然对你无效。
say:34:1820712503:0.male: No. You simply fainted. I didn't expect the potion to have no effect on you.
say:34:1820712503:0.female: No. You simply fainted. I didn't expect the potion to have no effect on you.

choice:2:1:2.text: My soul never left my body at all!
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 我完全没体验到灵魂出窍的感觉！
choice:2:1:2.male: My soul never left my body at all!
choice:2:1:2.female: My soul never left my body at all!

say:0:1820713001:0.text: Baba Muriel is right. I can learn some swordsmanship from Thane.
say:0:1820713001:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆说得对，我可以找瑟恩学一些剑术。
say:0:1820713001:0.male: Baba Muriel is right. I can learn some swordsmanship from Thane.
say:0:1820713001:0.female: Baba Muriel is right. I can learn some swordsmanship from Thane.

say:3:1820714002:1.text: You're a mage. Wouldn't that Graveborn woman be a better teacher for you?
say:3:1820714002:1.source_cn: 我看得出来你会魔法，或许向那位亡灵妇人讨教魔法更适合你。
say:3:1820714002:1.male: You're a mage. Wouldn't that Graveborn woman be a better teacher for you?
say:3:1820714002:1.female: You're a mage. Wouldn't that Graveborn woman be a better teacher for you?

choice_prompt:4:1820714002.text: You're a mage. Wouldn't that Graveborn woman be a better teacher for you?
choice_prompt:4:1820714002.source_cn: 我看得出来你会魔法，或许向那位亡灵妇人讨教魔法更适合你。
choice_prompt:4:1820714002.male: You're a mage. Wouldn't that Graveborn woman be a better teacher for you?
choice_prompt:4:1820714002.female: You're a mage. Wouldn't that Graveborn woman be a better teacher for you?

say:6:1820714004:2.text: Here. This sword is heavier than I'd give most beginners, but it's tough. You won't break it easily.
say:6:1820714004:2.source_cn: 拿好这把剑。虽然对新手而言有些重，但胜在韧性不错。
say:6:1820714004:2.male: Here. This sword is heavier than I'd give most beginners, but it's tough. You won't break it easily.
say:6:1820714004:2.female: Here. This sword is heavier than I'd give most beginners, but it's tough. You won't break it easily.

say:7:1820714005:1.text: Start with three hundred downward swings.
say:7:1820714005:1.source_cn: 然后，先练习劈砍三百下。
say:7:1820714005:1.male: Start with three hundred downward swings.
say:7:1820714005:1.female: Start with three hundred downward swings.

choice_prompt:8:1820714005.text: Start with three hundred downward swings.
choice_prompt:8:1820714005.source_cn: 然后，先练习劈砍三百下。
choice_prompt:8:1820714005.male: Start with three hundred downward swings.
choice_prompt:8:1820714005.female: Start with three hundred downward swings.

say:9:1820714006:1.text: When you're just starting out, strength will take you further than technique. Keep swinging, and you'll get stronger.
say:9:1820714006:1.source_cn: 对于新手，力量的实战作用远大于技巧，且练过就会有提升。
say:9:1820714006:1.male: When you're just starting out, strength will take you further than technique. Keep swinging, and you'll get stronger.
say:9:1820714006:1.female: When you're just starting out, strength will take you further than technique. Keep swinging, and you'll get stronger.

say:10:1820714007:1.text: I'll correct you as you go. One hundred swings per set. Start whenever you're ready.
say:10:1820714007:1.source_cn: 我会在一旁指导你。以一百次劈砍为一组，开始练习吧。
say:10:1820714007:1.male: I'll correct you as you go. One hundred swings per set. Start whenever you're ready.
say:10:1820714007:1.female: I'll correct you as you go. One hundred swings per set. Start whenever you're ready.

narration:12:1820714008:1.text: With Thane watching, you reluctantly begin swinging the sword.
narration:12:1820714008:1.male: With Thane watching, you reluctantly begin swinging the sword.
narration:12:1820714008:1.female: With Thane watching, you reluctantly begin swinging the sword.

narration:13:1820714009:1.text: You soon understand why Estrilda dreads training with him...
narration:13:1820714009:1.male: You soon understand why Estrilda dreads training with him...
narration:13:1820714009:1.female: You soon understand why Estrilda dreads training with him...

say:19:1820716001:1.source_cn: 你学得很快，领悟力很强。

choice_prompt:20:1820716001.source_cn: 你学得很快，领悟力很强。

say:21:1820716003:1.text: Now I'll show you a few simple moves you can actually use in a fight.
say:21:1820716003:1.source_cn: 接下来是一些简单有效的实战技巧，适合你这样的初学者。
say:21:1820716003:1.male: Now I'll show you a few simple moves you can actually use in a fight.
say:21:1820716003:1.female: Now I'll show you a few simple moves you can actually use in a fight.

say:22:1820716004:1.text: First, blocking. Catch the blow near the guard, where the blade is strongest. You'll have better control, and the sword is less likely to break.
say:22:1820716004:1.source_cn: 首先是格挡：格挡时需要用强部——就是靠近护手的部分。这...
say:22:1820716004:1.male: First, blocking. Catch the blow near the guard, where the blade is strongest. You'll have better control, and the sword is less likely to break.
say:22:1820716004:1.female: First, blocking. Catch the blow near the guard, where the blade is strongest. You'll have better control, and the sword is less likely to break.

say:23:1820716005:1.text: The section toward the tip is the weaker part of the blade. Use it for thrusts and slashes.
say:23:1820716005:1.source_cn: 与强部相对，剑尖的部分是弱部，用于突刺和劈砍。
say:23:1820716005:1.male: The section toward the tip is the weaker part of the blade. Use it for thrusts and slashes.
say:23:1820716005:1.female: The section toward the tip is the weaker part of the blade. Use it for thrusts and slashes.

say:24:1820716006:1.text: The Graveborn of Bantus have stiff bodies, so your blade may get stuck. If that happens, drive a knee into them or kick them away before they can grab you.
say:24:1820716006:1.source_cn: 班题斯亡灵的身体十分僵硬，若掌握不好力道，剑容易卡住。...
say:24:1820716006:1.male: The Graveborn of Bantus have stiff bodies, so your blade may get stuck. If that happens, drive a knee into them or kick them away before they can grab you.
say:24:1820716006:1.female: The Graveborn of Bantus have stiff bodies, so your blade may get stuck. If that happens, drive a knee into them or kick them away before they can grab you.

say:25:1820716007:1.text: They feel no pain and know no fear. Don't expect the usual tricks to work on them.
say:25:1820716007:1.source_cn: 他们没有痛觉，也不会恐惧，常规的控制手段是无效的。
say:25:1820716007:1.male: They feel no pain and know no fear. Don't expect the usual tricks to work on them.
say:25:1820716007:1.female: They feel no pain and know no fear. Don't expect the usual tricks to work on them.

say:26:1820716008:1.text: Target their joints. Once their movement is limited, they become easier to handle.
say:26:1820716008:1.source_cn: 着重攻击关节部位，便可削弱他们的行动力。
say:26:1820716008:1.male: Target their joints. Once their movement is limited, they become easier to handle.
say:26:1820716008:1.female: Target their joints. Once their movement is limited, they become easier to handle.

say:29:1820716010:1.text: You'll learn more by doing than by listening.
say:29:1820716010:1.source_cn: 比起理论，实践更为重要。
say:29:1820716010:1.male: You'll learn more by doing than by listening.
say:29:1820716010:1.female: You'll learn more by doing than by listening.

say:30:1820716011:1.text: Keep practicing. If we have time later, I'll show you more.
say:30:1820716011:1.source_cn: 抓紧时间练习吧。如果时间来得及，我再教你其他技巧。
say:30:1820716011:1.male: Keep practicing. If we have time later, I'll show you more.
say:30:1820716011:1.female: Keep practicing. If we have time later, I'll show you more.

say:31:1820716012:1.text: I can't afford to fail again... Not against Bantus.
say:31:1820716012:1.source_cn: 面对班题斯……这次我绝不能再次失误。
say:31:1820716012:1.male: I can't afford to fail again... Not against Bantus.
say:31:1820716012:1.female: I can't afford to fail again... Not against Bantus.

choice:28:1:2.text: Come on, teach me a few more tricks!
choice:28:1:2.male: Come on, teach me a few more tricks!
choice:28:1:2.female: Come on, teach me a few more tricks!

choice:20:0:1.text: I... think that was a compliment?
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 那还真是谢谢你的夸奖？
choice:20:0:1.male: I... think that was a compliment?
choice:20:0:1.female: I... think that was a compliment?

say:33:1820716002:1.text: She would be even stricter. She'd rather push you hard during training than watch you get hurt in a real fight.
say:33:1820716002:1.source_cn: 她只会比我更严格，因为她不希望你受伤。
say:33:1820716002:1.male: She would be even stricter. She'd rather push you hard during training than watch you get hurt in a real fight.
say:33:1820716002:1.female: She would be even stricter. She'd rather push you hard during training than watch you get hurt in a real fight.

choice:20:1:2.text: This was a mistake! I should've asked Estrilda to teach me!
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 我后悔了！我该去找爱丝的！
choice:20:1:2.male: This was a mistake! I should've asked Estrilda to teach me!
choice:20:1:2.female: This was a mistake! I should've asked Estrilda to teach me!

narration:34:180207110:0.text: Under Thane's guidance, you begin training diligently in swordsmanship...
narration:34:180207110:0.source_cn: 在瑟恩的指导下，你刻苦地练习起剑术……
narration:34:180207110:0.male: Under Thane's guidance, you begin training diligently in swordsmanship...
narration:34:180207110:0.female: Under Thane's guidance, you begin training diligently in swordsmanship...

choice:8:0:1.text: Three hundred? On my first day?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 三百下？！这会不会太多了？！
choice:8:0:1.male: Three hundred? On my first day?
choice:8:0:1.female: Three hundred? On my first day?

choice:8:1:2.text: Dura above, I've hardly ever held a sword!
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我还是初学者啊！
choice:8:1:2.male: Dura above, I've hardly ever held a sword!
choice:8:1:2.female: Dura above, I've hardly ever held a sword!

choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 要不我还是去学亡灵魔法吧……

choice:4:0:1.text: I've only just become Graveborn. I can't use gravecalling.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 我是新亡者，不会亡灵魔法
choice:4:0:1.male: I've only just become Graveborn. I can't use gravecalling.
choice:4:0:1.female: I've only just become Graveborn. I can't use gravecalling.

choice:4:1:2.text: I lost my magic when I became Graveborn!
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 变成亡灵以后，我的魔力都消失了！
choice:4:1:2.male: I lost my magic when I became Graveborn!
choice:4:1:2.female: I lost my magic when I became Graveborn!

choice:2:0:1.text: Could you teach me how to use a sword?
choice:2:0:1.male: Could you teach me how to use a sword?
choice:2:0:1.female: Could you teach me how to use a sword?
